body.interpretation: Read the 64-bit field at [param_2 + 0x20]; if non-zero add 1 (counter = counter + (counter != 0)); write back. Then load the vtable pointer from [this] and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the virtual function at vtable byte offset 0xca8 (index 401). No other side effects.

pattern_note: Identical shape to every other AFortCreativeMoveTool input handler (e.g. HandleDeletePressed 0x1428c2bc0 -> vtable 0xc80, HandleActorSelectedForQueuePressed 0x1428c2ae0 -> vtable 0xdf8). All are a non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of [param_2+0x20] followed by a tail jump to a class vtable slot. The vtable slot holds the real handler body; the reflected exec entry is only the counter side-effect plus the dispatch.
unresolved_contracts: Virtual function identity at AFortCreativeMoveTool vtable byte offset 0xca8 (the real CopyPickup handler body) is not identified.
